newsitem.title: USA: Duquesne Energy to produce fuel pellets.
newsitem.headline: Duquesne Energy to produce fuel pellets.

text.p: Duquesne Energy Inc said Monday it entered into an alliance and an exclusive licensing arrangement with CQ Inc, a fuel technology company located in Homer City, Pa.
Duquesne Energy said it will build plants to produce a pelletized fuel product which combines coal and by-products of the manufacture of paper and plastic.
This product will be sold under the trademark E-Fuel, the DQE Inc affiliate said.
It said E-Fuel can be used as an alternative fuel in a variety of industries which use coal.
CQ is producing E-Fuel for industrial use.
CQ's operating experience has demonstrated that emissions of nitrogen oxides (NOx) and sulfur dioxide are some 25 percent lower using E-Fuel, that company said.
